entries.statement: P1-SLIVER-D2 (SR-P1-SLIVER-D2, madhav-44): the builder and, independently in its own code, the verifier each exclude from a window's MAXIMUM any piece shorter than the stored-edge resolution at that instant = one JD-double ulp, COMPUTED (math.ulp(jd) * 86400 s, never a literal). A record's stored support end and the lord's sign change are the same sky event computed on two paths <= 21 us apart; a maximum that exists only on such a piece is not a sky configuration (N.7.6). The excluded pieces are counted per window (qualification.certificate.sliver_pieces_excluded, the generic member migration 1402 admits; absent = none excluded) and listed as kind 'sliver' in the solver certificate's geometry. A window whose only positive piece was a sliver is numbered by the pieces that remain (possibly 0.0). Cause commit 604963d43 changes window_solver, window_sweep, window_solver_check and window_verifier only (window-stage modules). Geometry and evaluation are unchanged. Measured on harness-built records (chronic_onset 10 of 138 P1 windows change value, illness_acute 10 of 138, major_loss 9 of 63, parental_event 15 of 149; no P2/P3/P4 window changes value). Last re-derivation before the TR. Derived pins carried by this entry: the window golden pin (test_mb_ordinary_golden.py); services/gochara_kernel/implementation_digest.lock.json regenerated with its own --write (it was already stale at the base head, registering the pre-amend-5 digests 5721a21c / geometry 5ec80159, so test_the_committed_lock_is_current_for_the_code_in_this_checkout could not pass there); century_contract.json image.writer_source_digest 48f50d1c -> e4433b5f (--check said the image differed; equal after).
entries.excluded_piece_rule: a piece [a, b) of a window's elementary pieces with (b - a) in seconds < math.ulp(JD(a)) * 86400, JD(a) the Julian Day double of its start, is no candidate for the maximum; the pieces on either side keep their own values and edges; a 10 ms piece (a different rung) is never excluded
